verdict.rationale: BILL's v3 API covers a wide range of S&E functionality (budgets, users, virtual cards, transactions, reimbursements, vendor management, org structure, webhooks) matching many UI capabilities, and docs explicitly note API-driven org/vendor/budget management. However, some UI-configurable features (custom approval policies, purchase order tolerance rules, 2/3-way matching) are only described in pricing pages, not confirmed as API-exposed, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s across standard paths), suggesting incomplete parity or discoverability. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints/docs for approval-policy customization and purchase-order workflows, and a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec confirming full UI-API parity.
